title: Warm Resinous Australian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, chewy lamb stew with resinous flavors, featuring lamb shanks and kombu-cold-extract, perfect for a midnight craving. This shojin-friendly dish is cooked to perfection in a donabe vessel.
instructions: Preheat the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the vegetable oil and swirl it around to coat the bottom of the donabe.
Brown the lamb shanks on all sides, then set them aside.
Soften the chopped onion and minced garlic in the donabe.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, cooking until they start to soften.
Return the lamb shanks to the donabe and add the kombu cold extract, water, rosemary, and black pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Remove the kombu sheets and rosemary sprigs before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional rosemary if desired.
